title: Audit chronicle schema and changeframe guidelines for RBAC v2 and SSO-linked admin operations
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define a compact, searchable, privacy-aware audit event chronicle and changeframe format for RBAC v2 admin operations (including SSO/SAML-linked identities). Deliverables: canonical event taxonomy, minimal changeframe diff encoding, per-field redaction/pseudonymization rules, retention/sampling guidance, and integration points for Console and Dedicated/Private deployments.
motivation: Current audit payloads are large and inconsistent across services — makes reconstruction, lineage, and alerting slow and error-prone.
RBAC v2 introduces richer intent semantics (role inheritance, policy bundles) and we must capture those changes efficiently for compliance and incident forensics.
SSO/SAML linkage requires preserving actionable identity ties without leaking PII — we need consistent actor representation and confidence scores.
Console and external auditors need compact, queryable events with guaranteed privacy controls and clear retention semantics.
scope: Canonical event envelope for admin actions (create/update/delete/attach/detach/role-grant/role-revoke).
Changeframe/delta encoding to capture field-level edits with an option for full snapshots when required by compliance.
Actor identity model: primary actor (user/service), assertion reference (SAML/SSO), derived actor (impersonation/service token) and confidence score.
Target model: resource canonical refs (user, role, policy, group, tenant, project) and pre/post lightweight state.
Redaction and pseudonymization rules for PII fields, and a deterministic hashing scheme for IP/host identifiers when required.
Indexing key set for Console (time, actor_hash, target_type, action, policy_id, change_set_hash).
Integration doc links and example serializers for ingestion pipeline, storage schema (cold/hot), and retention policies.
acceptance_criteria: Schema document published in Confluence with examples for each admin action type.
Changeframe encoding (compact delta) implemented in two services: admin-api and rbac-service as schema-v1 compatible envelopes.
End-to-end test that reconstructs a role grant timeline from stored changeframes and full snapshots for at least one tenant.
Console can render pre/post diffs for policy edits using the compact format without requesting raw snapshots by default.
Security review sign-off on pseudonymization scheme and SAML assertion linkage approach.
decision_log: Chose compact changeframe (patch op list) over full always-on snapshots to save storage and reduce ingestion latency — snapshots optional for high-risk changes.
Use deterministic hailstone hashing for client IPs and host identifiers to preserve forensic linking without storing raw PII in hot indices.
SAML assertions will be referenced by assertion_id and stored in a separate encrypted store for auditors; events will include assertion_id and actor_confidence to avoid inline PII.
Adopted semantic action vocabulary (intent-first) rather than verb-only logs (e.g., 'role.binding.create' vs 'write') to simplify downstream policy analytics.
diff_encoding_proposal: Envelope fields: event_id, ts_utc, action, actor_ref, actor_confidence, assertion_id, target_refs, locale, route, request_id, session_id_hash, client_ip_hash, service_context, trace_id, changeframe, snapshot_ref(optional), retention_class.
Changeframe: list of ops {op: add|remove|replace|move|copy, path: JSONPath, value: base64-or-primitive, meta: {field_confidence:int, redact_hint}} encoded as compact array to minimize bytes.
Changeframe representation will prefer typed small values; long strings are stored as blob_refs with content-addressed references.
Use change_set_hash (SHA256) to deduplicate identical patchsets and to speed query joins between events and snapshots.
actor_model: actor_confidence: integer 0-100 reflecting SSO assertion freshness, MFA presence, token type, and impersonation flags.
assertion_id: SAML assertion or OIDC id_token reference (stored encrypted in assertions-store; event only contains pointer).
derived_actor: present when action executed by a delegated role or service on behalf of a user — include delegation_chain as list of actor_refs (max depth 5).
target_model: target_refs: stable canonical refs for resources e.g., 'role:global:billing-admin', 'policy:org:12345:restrict-ssh'.
target_preview: small, scrubbed pre-state for quick Console preview (max 600 chars).
full_snapshot_ref: optional content-addressed snapshot stored in cold storage when required by retention class or compliance.
privacy_and_redaction: PII fields marked with redact_hint will be redacted in hot indices and replaced with deterministic hashed placeholders when stored (e.g., user.email -> user.email_hash).
Retention_class tiers: ephemeral (30d), standard (365d), compliance (7y). Events with compliance tags require full snapshot persistence.
Access to decrypted assertion payloads is gated via KMS-ACL and audited separately; event consumers do not receive raw assertion contents.
operational_guidance: Sampling: For noisy resources (frequent policy checks), sample full snapshots at 1% default and all changeframes; increase snapshoting for escalations.
Indexing: Only index the minimal key set; avoid indexing full snapshots. Use change_set_hash and target/type indices for most queries.
Alerting: Define high-severity rule for 'role.binding.create' where actor_confidence < 50 and target is admin role.
Migration: Provide middleware shim to translate existing audit payloads to the new envelope for 90-day coexistence.
progress_updates: 2025-02-18: Draft canonical envelope posted to the security channel — initial feedback requested from Console and Compliance teams.
2025-02-22: Workshop with Infra and Storage — agreed on blob_ref store for long fields and content-addressed snapshots for cold retention.
2025-02-26: Prototype changeframe serializer implemented in rbac-service branch 'audit/compact-delta' (PR link below).
2025-03-02: Security review kickoff scheduled; compliance asked for examples of 7-year snapshot retrieval flow.
review_feedback: Console: prefer 'target_previews' to be JSON-LD succinct summaries to make UI diffing deterministic.
Storage: recommended adding change_set_hash to event header for efficient joins in BigQuery and OLAP layers.
Compliance: require that any event tagged 'policy_elevate' must include a snapshot_ref stored before the change.
implementation_plan: Week 1: Finalize schema and get security/compliance sign-off.
Week 2-3: Implement changeframe serializer and middleware in rbac-service and admin-api; add event header and assertion pointer logic.
Week 4: Deploy consumer adapters in ingestion pipeline and index minimal keys; enable alerting rules on test tenants.
Week 5: Migrate producers behind feature flag, run reconciliation jobs, and prepare migration runbook for on-call.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Excessive snapshoting increases storage costs. Mitigation: use retention_class tagging and default sampling for non-critical changes.
Risk: Mis-linkage of SAML assertion to event could leak PII. Mitigation: store assertions encrypted with strict ACLs and only include opaque assertion_id in hot events.
Risk: Old services emitting legacy payloads. Mitigation: provide translation shim and monitor error rate; deprecate legacy format after 90 days.
testing_plan: Unit tests for serializer/deserializer with edge-case ops (move, copy, binary blobs).
Integration test that replays a simulated tenant's admin history and validates Console reconstruction accuracy.
CHAOS test: simulate assertion_store unavailability and ensure events still ingest with assertion_id absent and actor_confidence flagged.
notes: This doc uses the term 'chronicle' to emphasize an append-only reconstructable timeline rather than ephemeral audit rows.
Changeframe v1 must be forward-compatible; include a small 'flags' header to allow pluggable op extensions.
